notes.title: WYRMHALL is on sale! Also, introducing wizbuilder!
notes.content:
Heya gobs!

WYRMHALL is on sale until Tuesday 10AM PDT!

Also, we've just released wizbuilder! A silly wizard creator set in the WYRMHALL universe! You can customize your very own wizard's appearance, apparel and even give them magical accessories!

When you're ready you can generate a madlibs-style backstory based on your choices! You'll learn about their life, how they gained their skillz and how they got their title!

It's free, and out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673360/wizbuilder/

notes.title: Small update with a few fixes!
notes.content:
Heya gobs!

We’ve updated the game with a few fixes and changes based on some of the reports and feedback we received!

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Thrumby’s Clean off - Adjusted some of the messes to make them easier to spot
[*] Fixed a clipping mesh in the wyrmdoor tickets ending cutscene
[*] On a second playthrough the fairy cage can now be examined again instead of being treated as a familiar form of currency
[*] Fixed an issue where the quality options were blank by default
[*] Fixed a user-interface issue that failed to show the gamepad shortcuts for the pryers and the knife
[/list]

[b]Localization All Languages[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few missing lines that were reverting back to english
[/list]

[b]Localization German[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the € symbol from the gob-speak lines as it ended up being more distracting than charming
[*] Fixed a handful of minor issues
[/list]

Thank you for all of your kind words and feedback, it’s been really heartwarming to read.

Best,
The Leafy Games Team

notes.title: WYRMHALL: Brush and Banter - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Welcome![/h1]

It is our sincere pleasure to welcome you to the weird and wondrous world of WYRMHALL!✨

We had SUCH a fun time making this silly game, that even if a fraction of that fun makes its way to you it will be a success in our eyes. We'd appreciate any feedback or reviews, it helps a lot.🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157664/7adc27fd72b3d14d98ea623a7d97dfc94426f789.jpg[/img]

For those wanting to learn more about the game before purchasing, you can check out the demo here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3186670/WYRMHALL_Brush_and_Banter_Demo/

Thank for your time!

Best Wishes,
The Leafy Games Team

notes.title: Brush and Banter Releases March 7th!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that WYRMHALL: Brush and Banter will be releasing on Friday March 7th! (Barring any magical schisms or reality collapses.)

That’s right! In just a couple weeks, you can live your dream of cleaning magical artifacts as a silly gob! That was your dream…right?

In the meantime check out our demo! It’s available now and we will be participating in next week’s Next Fest!

If you haven’t wishlisted and are looking for more reasons to do so, here are a few:

[list]
[*] There is a duck in the game!
[*] You can clean the duck!
[*] The duck honks sometimes!
[*] The duck makes a second appearance (in the background)!
[*] End of list.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo and Project Updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! WYRMHALL: Brush and Banter now supports 4 additional languages!

French, German, Portuguese (Brazil), and Simplified Chinese!

You should see these language options, as well as a few fixes and tweaks in the demo now!

Best,
The Leafy Games Team
